style: Figurative flat illustration for a language-learning app, in the spirit of a mid-century children's picture book with a touch of graphic simplification: the subject is drawn naturally and is instantly recognizable, with real proportions, a natural pose and a simple face, but details are reduced to clean flat colour shapes, slightly stylized, with medium-weight ink-navy outlines and no gradients, textures or fine details like fabric folds. Limited warm palette: ink-navy (#1f3a5f), terracotta (#c9683b), mustard (#d9a441), sage (#7a9a7e), soft blue and cream, on a plain warm off-white paper background (#fbf8f3) with no decorative shapes behind the subject. Show only the named subject, no extra objects or props. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, single subject centered with generous margins.
